caption: New Jersey Civil Justice Institute v. Grewal
citation_line: New Jersey Civil Justice Institute v. Grewal, No. 3:19-cv-17518 (D.N.J. Mar. 25, 2021)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Thompson granted summary judgment and enjoined enforcement of N.J.S.A. § 10:5-12.7 against employment arbitration agreements governed by the Federal Arbitration Act, holding that the state provision was FAA-preempted.
qualification_rationale: The ruling drew New Jersey legal and political press because it invalidated, in significant part, a state employment-law measure designed to prevent prospective waiver of statutory and jury-trial rights.
appellate_posture_note: No published Third Circuit merits disposition was identified in this research. The significance rests on the district injunction and its immediate effect on New Jersey employment arbitration.
